description: Checked-in upstream licence texts for crates whose published .crate files omit a licence file. scripts/generate-notices.sh verifies each file against sha256 and cites the pinned upstream source in packaging/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Add a new entry only with a verbatim upstream file; never hand-write a copyright line.

mit.note: LICENSE.md at the 0.6.x release tags states that objc2, block2, objc2-foundation, and objc2-encode are MIT, but it does not reproduce the licence text. The checked-in text is LICENSE.txt at 4fc083f1, byte-identical to rust-objc's 9961247 (2016) file; upstream removed LICENSE.txt at cfb1992 (2025-01-22) and re-added LICENSE-MIT.txt at ee9a7ada (2026-03-18) with 'Copyright 2026 Mads Marquart'. The retained MIT line is the original 2016 notice, and the text is not changed here.

dispatch 0.2.0's own repository never had a licence file; the copyright holder (Steven Sheldon) comes from its Cargo.toml authors field, and the text is that author's verbatim MIT licence from the adjacent rust-objc project.
The v0.1.0 tag predates the LICENSE file; this pin is the upstream commit that added the project's MIT text.
